children: PennyMac provided a 3Q26 investor update showing lower production-driven pretax income but higher servicing pretax income and an owned portfolio of $503 billion in UPB.
3Q26 production pretax income expected lower than 2Q26 as mortgage rates rose ~50 bps and pull-through adjusted lock volume declined.
Revenue margin for production expected 75–85 basis points versus 77 basis points in 2Q26.
Servicing pretax income expected higher than 2Q26 despite MSR cash flows declining 10%+ due to lower prepayment speeds.
Owned servicing portfolio UPB at $503 billion, up from June 30, as production offset prepayment runoff.
